title: All-hands story arc and ask matrix (Q1 kickoff rehearsal)
content:
Purpose: draft a tightly framed story arc for the Q1 all-hands that connects company north star -> FY25 OKR hypotheses -> concrete team asks + follow-ups. This is a working rehearsal doc: rough language, stage directions, and a matrix of micro-asks so leaders can practice concise asks (30s each).

Key constraints / guiding principles:
- 25–30 minute total executive segment (CEO + two execs) then 30 min of breakout micro-asks / Q&A. Keep exec remarks <7m each.
- Narrative must move: why we ship Dedicated & Private now (customer momentum), how runtime reliability improvements unlock $/token reductions, and the immediate cadence to hit unit economics targets.
- Ask matrix should surface only the top 2 asks per org; each ask is ownerable, measurable, and has a 6-week outcome.
- Minimize new acronyms in the presentation; link to deeper docs for those who want to dig.

Story arc (high level) — 3 acts (for rehearsal run):
Act 1: Status and Context (2–3m)
- CEO quick pulse: where we are vs. the 90-day bar (candor: wins + top two risks).
- One data moment: latency SLO attainment % and cost-per-inference trend (chart link in artifacts).
Stage note: show single slide with two numbers, no dense bullets.

Act 2: Why this matters (4–6m)
- Product lead (or Head of Serving) frames the 'serving thesis' — serving != model access; it9s predictable economics + reliability.
- Short example customer vignette: SaaS startup cut inference cost 38% via batching/quantization suggestions.
- Callout: Dedicated customers we9ve onboarded this quarter and lessons learned (ops friction checklist).
Stage note: use customer quote, but anonymize; rehearsed lines for CEO to echo.

Act 3: The asks + the path (6–8m)
- Exec: two specific cross-company asks (30s each) + owners.
- Ask examples (matrix entries):
  - "Lower unit token cost by 15% in 6 weeks" -> owner: infra-cost-optim (Evan) -> quick wins: enable cache-on-start default; roll quantized model variante to staging.
  - "Improve per-route latency P50 to <80ms for PG-1 customers" -> owner: serving-runtime (Rosa) -> quick wins: prioritized kernel tuning + tail latency tracing.
- For each ask provide: owner, metric (baseline + target), 6-week milestone, potential blockers, fallback play.

Breakouts / Micro-asks segment (30m)
- Format: 6 teams x 5m each (2m micro-ask + 3m clarifying Q&A).
- Teams: infra, serving-runtime, product-hosted-api, customer-success, platform-eng, developer-experience.
- Pre-assigned moderators and note-taker for decision log.

Ask matrix (sample rows):
- Row format: ask | owner | metric (baseline -> target) | 6-week milestone | blocker | fallback
- Entry 1: "Enable automated prefix caching for top-10 endpoints" | Leah (Platform Eng) | 10% cache hit -> 45% | pilot on 3 routes | incompat with old SDK clients | fallback: route-by-route opt-in toggle
- Entry 2: "Canary quantized model rollout for large-chat" | Rosa (Serving) | 0% quant->30% -> 6-week milestone: 1% traffic on quantized | risk: regression in hallucination rate | fallback: automated rollback + synthetic eval gate
- Entry 3: "Customer onboarding playbook for Dedicated" | Marcus (Solutions Eng) | avg onboarding time 21d -> 12d | milestone: new playbook + two pilot customers | blocker: infra provisioning lag | fallback: temporary manual provisioning SLA

Rehearsal checklist (who does what):
- CEO: 1x run-through of 7m script, emphasize candor line at minute 1. (Leah to supply one-sentence anchor lines)
- Product/Serving exec: demo-ready customer vignette (have 30s soundbite).
- Ops: ensure two numbers slide (latency & cost) is final visuals by 2/25.
- Communications: pre-baked FAQ for top 5 questions; one-pager for managers with micro-ask owners + next steps.

Decision log / follow-ups (live during all-hands):
- Use Confluence + Decision Log template (link above). Make sure each accepted ask has: owner, deadline, success metric, and follow-up meeting.

Open questions / unresolved items (notes-to-self):
- Do we want to publicly show a Dedicated roadmap milestone? legal signoff? (Action: Leah to check with Legal)
- How tight are we on the 30m breakout slot if execs run over? contingency: reduce to 20m and extend async follow-ups.
- Which customer vignette is cleared for mention—Rosa to confirm by 2/18.

Communication plan after show:
- Quick comms bundle (30–45 min post-event): exec recap email + ask-matrix snapshot + links to tickets for each ask owner. Managers asked to run local team-30m sync within 72 hours.

Next steps (owners + dates):
- 2/17: finalize micro-ask list (Leah)
- 2/20: slide deck draft v0 (Design + Comms)
- 2/24: rehearsals (CEO + 2 execs) -> Leah to coordinate calendar
- 3/03: All-hands live

Appendix: rehearsal script snippets (very rough)
- CEO open: "Quick reset: we're shipping a platform, not a toy — that means predictable economics, real SLAs, and product work that reduces our customer's TCO. Here are two blunt things we need from the org this quarter..."
- Product close: "If we move these three levers, we materially improve both developer experience and unit economics. That9s the job for Q1."

Notes / tone: keep short, operative, and a bit direct. This is not the PR deck; it is the internal playbook for leadership to land asks and create immediate follow-through.
